notes: Torah #100 has zero cause/effect (eitza/cause) edges in the dataset. The existing packages file (torah_100_packages.json) also contains zero bechina packages and zero nodes, as confirmed by the gap analysis in torah_100_additions.json. Torah #100 is a four-sentence teaching explaining why some true tzaddikim appear angry: when their Torah attainment exceeds their deeds, the holy fire of Torah boils within them. The entire teaching is a pure causal chain (Torah light -> righteousness, Torah-deeds imbalance -> holy fire -> difficult temperament), but none of these relationships were encoded as edges in the dataset. With zero edges of any type, there are no nodes to assign to packages.
